player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma spanning {num_rounds} rounds.

Game Structure:
- Before each decision you have {total_conversation_rounds} turns to communicate freely.
- After that, both players simultaneously choose to cooperate or defect.

Payoff Matrix (fixed each round):
- Both Cooperate ➜ each {cooperate_reward}
- Both Defect ➜ each {mutual_defect_reward}
- One Defects, one Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

How to Play:
- During conversation: type any text you wish.
- During decision phase: include '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). You may add extra text before/after the token.

phases.conversation_finished: Polelo e feditse ka round {round}. Le ka araba '[Cooperate]' kana '[Defect]' ka nako e kwadilwego \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Bobedi bja bona ba ile ba dira {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Bapetšhi ka bobedi ba ile ba dirišana.
outcome.round_both_defect: Bobedi bja bona ba ile ba hlanogela mmušo.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Sebapadi 0 se ile sa dirišana le rena, sebapadi 1 sona se ile tša tšhaba.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Sebapadi 0 se ile sa hlanogela mmušo, sebapadi 1 se ile tša dirišana le sona.
